_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (claudedocs/client-modules.md / claudedocs/server.md, '单文件 500 行收敛'), as of 2026-08-11. checkFileLength.mjs fails CI only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, or a listed file grows past the line count recorded here. Splitting a file below 500 lines does not require touching this file (the script reports it as a housekeeping notice instead of failing) but you should still delete its entry. Do not bump a recorded number to silence a GREW violation — that defeats the point; split the file or, if truly justified, explain why in claudedocs/client-modules.md next to this edit. 17 of these 38 are mixin-chain base/domain files being worked through per claudedocs/client-modules.md's composition-priority note — deleting an entry here as a batch lands is expected, not a baseline violation. `src/net/ApiClient.ts` (added 2026-08-11) and `src/net/WorldApiClient.ts` (already tracked; shrunk 712→534 by the same conversion) are thin one-line-per-endpoint forwarding facades over a composition split — every line exists because dozens of call sites across the codebase already call `apiClient.methodName(...)`/`worldApi.methodName(...)` directly; splitting the facade further would fragment the forward list without reducing complexity (no shared state, no cross-domain logic to separate). Justified exceptions, not debt to shrink. `src/scenes/CityScene/core.ts` (2026-08-11, was `CityScene/base.ts` 718) grew slightly to 752 in the same conversion — it's the single shared-state+business-logic root (data loading/network actions/icon resolution/input/shared layout helpers) that both domain classes (render.ts, modals.ts) depend on; render.ts/modals.ts/teamRow.ts/trainModal.ts were all pulled back under 500 by extracting their self-contained sub-renderers into sibling form-① modules, but core.ts has no such natural further seam without arbitrarily fragmenting one cohesive state object.
